newsitem.title: USA: Rockwell names executives of spin-off.
newsitem.headline: Rockwell names executives of spin-off.

text.p: Rockwell International Corp Monday named the team of executives who will run Rockwell Automotive when it is spun off from the parent company, which is expected at the end of September.

Larry Yost, currently president of Rockwell Automotive, will be named chairman and chief executive officer. Robert Calder, currently president of the light vehicle systems division, will be president of the spin-off.
Thomas Madden, currently senior vice president finance at Rockwell Automotive, will be senior vice president and chief financial officer of the new company.
Last March, Rockwell announced that it planned to establish its automotive component systems businesses as an independent, separately-traded, publicly-held company.
The Automotive unit's new name and identity will be announced in mid-August.
